about.title: A nonprofit built on the Triple Helix model
about.description: CSI A.C. is the startup and innovation cluster of Puebla. It brings government, academia and industry together so building a tech startup in the state becomes the rule. Nonprofit, open governance and measurable results.
about.imageAlt: Triple Helix model diagram: government, academia and industry

hub.title: A physical space to build, at CERHAN II
hub.description: The CSI Innovation Hub operates at CERHAN II with open infrastructure for makers, startups and industry teams: a FabLab with digital fabrication, an AI laboratory with GPU compute, and an auditorium for the community.
hub.fabLabDescription: Digital fabrication: 3D printing, laser cutting and prototyping electronics.
hub.iaLabDescription: GPU compute and technical support for teams training models.
hub.auditoriumDescription: A venue for demo days, workshops and cluster working sessions.
hub.imageFabLabAlt: FabLab at the CSI Innovation Hub in CERHAN II
